parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence](~~25693~~).

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the replication pair-consistent group. You can call the [DescribeDiskReplicaGroups](~~426614~~) operation to query the IDs of replication pair-consistent groups.

parameters.name: ReplicaGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the replication pair-consistent group. You can call the [DescribeDiskReplicaGroups](~~426614~~) operation to query the IDs of replication pair-consistent groups.

parameters.name: ReverseReplicate
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable the reverse replication sub-feature. Valid values: true and false. Default value: true.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ebs reprotect-disk-replica-group --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --replica-group-id pg-myreplica0000 --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --reverse-replicate true --region cn-hangzhou
